invalid_request.summary: The body or query is malformed: an unknown field or query parameter, a bad value, or a wrong-shaped payload; `param` names the culprit.

invalid_link.summary: A link field names an element that does not exist in this world (or among a /bulk batch's surviving items).

id_conflict.summary: A create supplied an id that already exists, in this world or another (element ids are unique across all worlds).

resync_required.summary: A guest's, or (with the hidden mark on) a contributor's, /changes cursor predates a change to what it can see, or is not this caller's cursor shape: pull again from since=0. With the hidden mark on, the envelope's `reason` says why: `role` (your own role or membership moved: keep what the new walk does not name) or `view` (what you may see moved: drop it).

already_member.summary: The invite names someone who is already a member, or the accepting account already is one.

removal_in_flight.summary: A removal ticket for this image was issued less than 10 minutes ago and is not yet spent; use it, or retry after Retry-After.

upload_pending.summary: No image is recorded under this key yet, but an upload ticket in this world is still open and unreported (the upload may have just finished); retry after Retry-After (2 s). The platform cannot tell which key an open ticket will get, so any key answers this while the caller holds one, until it expires; then not_found.

pin_required.summary: A member without an account PIN tried to mint a write key. Accepting an invite or a link needs no PIN.

precondition_failed.summary: The request carried If-Match with a change_seq, and the element has moved since; the reply's top-level `current` is the element as it is now. Nothing was written and nothing is merged: re-read `current`, then re-send or ask the user.

player_role_fixed.summary: The owner tried to change a player seat's role: a player (no account) reads as a guest, and that role can't be changed. Remove the player instead.

character_hidden.summary: The owner tried to set a hidden Character as the one a seat or a player plays (`param` character): a played Character is on every reader's roster, so a hidden one can never be picked. Unhide it first, or pick another.

known_of_not_writable.summary: A write body carried `known_of` (`param` known_of): that key marks a stub, an element the reader knows of but does not see whole, and is never written. A stub sent back would blank every field it leaves out: drop `known_of` and send only the fields you mean to change.

character_taken.summary: A player picked a Character from a party link's list that a live seat in the world already plays (`param` character): pick another from the list. The preview marks each listed Character `taken`.

world_full.summary: A player link was opened in a world that already has its 50 live players: nothing was spent, and the link works again once the owner removes a player.

field_not_visible.summary: A proposal named a field the proposer's own view of the element does not hold (`param` names it): the element reaches this reader only as a stub (known_of), and a proposal changes only what its proposer can read.

too_many_open.summary: A proposer already has 5 open proposals on this element, or 50 in this world: wait for a keeper to decide, or withdraw one. A lapsed proposal no longer counts.

stale_proposal.summary: An accept found that a field the proposal names has moved since it was made. Beside the envelope, `conflicts` lists each moved field with its `base` and `current` values, and `current` is the element as it is now. Nothing was written and the proposal stays open; the proposer proposes again on the current text.

not_proposed.summary: A review (accept or decline of a new element written as proposed) named an element that carries no `x_review_proposed` mark: nothing to settle. A change to an existing element is proposed and decided through its proposals instead.

apply_failed.summary: A /bulk item passed validation but its write failed a database constraint (most often an id that already exists in another world).

invalid_grant.summary: Sign in with OnlyWorlds: the code cannot be exchanged (POST /api/v2/auth/token). It is unknown, already used, expired (a code lives 60 seconds), or was issued for another client, another redirect_uri or another code_verifier. One answer for every case, byte for byte, and the code is spent either way: start the sign-in again.

file_too_large.summary: A file asked to be attached to an element is over 25 MB; the message gives both sizes (`param` size).

invalid_credentials.summary: The API key or PIN is missing, unrecognised or wrong. A PIN refusal names param API-Pin and says whether the PIN was missing or wrong.

key_revoked.summary: The API key was recognised but has been revoked.

permission_error.summary: The credential is valid but lacks the scope for this route (e.g. a read key on a write route).

not_author.summary: A contributor or guest key changed, replaced, relinked or deleted an element someone else created.

hidden_not_allowed.summary: A create (POST, a PUT of a new id, a /bulk item that creates) carried `hidden: true` from a key that may not hide: only the world's owner and its co-builders (person or seat) may. Nothing was created. Leave `hidden` out, or ask a keeper.

owner_only.summary: A member key tried to change the world's own settings (a co-builder may change time_range_current, the extension keys, source and producer, and nothing else).

view_as_owner_only.summary: A member key sent `as` (view as): reading as another reader is the owner's, from a key with no member.

guest_not_supported.summary: A guest key called a route guests cannot use yet, or wrote a note (Narrative) without a Character of its own in the world.

proposed_only.summary: The world takes an agent seat's writes as proposals (its owner's setting), and this act has no proposal form: a seat deleting an element it did not create, or accepting or declining a proposal. Propose instead, or ask a keeper. Also, on any world, a member accepting or declining a new element its own mark proposed: a keeper settles it.

own_proposal.summary: A keeper tried to accept their own proposal: another keeper (the world's owner or a co-builder) decides it.

storage_full.summary: The account the upload counts against has used all of its image storage.

files_full.summary: The world's files have no room for this one (250 MB a world); the message gives the world's use, its cap and the file's size. Remove a file, or ask the owner.

not_found.summary: The element or route does not exist in this world.

gone.summary: The element was deleted from this world; the body carries the deletion's `change_seq` and `deleted_at` beside the envelope (GET of one element only).

rate_limited.summary: Too many failed PIN attempts, or too many sign-in attempts from one address (the password sign-in and POST /api/v2/auth/token share one count); retry after the Retry-After header's seconds.

quota_exceeded.summary: A daily limit is used up (the world's image upload tickets, its file upload tickets, or the account's token rating for AI); retry after Retry-After.

too_many_requests.summary: Over the request budget: 300 requests a minute per key or account token, 60 a minute per address for a request with neither, reads and writes together (a /bulk call is one request); retry after Retry-After. Every reply carries RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset.

idempotency_error.summary: An Idempotency-Key was reused with a different request body.

idempotency_in_flight.summary: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still running; retry after Retry-After (1 s): once it has answered, the same key and body replay its answer.

api_error.summary: An unexpected server-side error; the envelope is kept even here.

ask_failed.summary: The AI proxy could not get an answer from the model; try again in a moment. Nothing was counted.

ask_unavailable.summary: Asking your world is not switched on for this server, or is paused for the day (the server-wide cap); nothing was counted.

server_busy.summary: Every request slot stayed full for 10 seconds; retry after Retry-After.

payload_too_large.summary: The request body is over 2.5 MB; split a large /bulk into several calls.

media_unavailable.summary: Image or file upload is not configured on the server right now.

already_reported.summary: The upload Worker reported a ticket's upload again with different values (POST /api/v2/media/uploaded, edge-only; the same values answer 204).

ticket_required.summary: No ticket: send it as Authorization: Bearer <ticket>.

ticket_invalid.summary: The ticket is not valid: send it exactly as issued.

ticket_expired.summary: The ticket is past its expiry (issued for 10 minutes; the edge allows 60 s grace): get a new one.

ticket_used.summary: One ticket, one upload: get a new one for the next image.

bad_key.summary: The X-Key is not allowed (prefix, characters outside a-z 0-9 . _ - and single slashes, over 200 characters, or an extension that does not match the bytes); the response carries a `reason`.

empty_body.summary: No image bytes in the request.

exists.summary: The key is taken and objects are never overwritten: for an image, choose another X-Key or omit it; for a file, the ticket's key is already stored (a retry after a success reads this as done).

too_large.summary: The image is over the ticket's max_bytes.

unsupported_type.summary: An image must be webp, png, jpeg or avif; a file on an element must be a pdf, a text kind (txt, md, json, csv, yaml, toml) or a world's own zip bundle (the type is read from the bytes).

write_failed.summary: Nothing was stored and the ticket is still unspent: retry with the same ticket.

not_removable.summary: The image is not one the removal ticket's world uploaded with a ticket, so it cannot be removed this way.

remove_failed.summary: Nothing was removed and the removal ticket is still unspent: retry with the same ticket.

ticket_lane_unconfigured.summary: Uploads (images and files alike) are not configured on the host right now: retry later.
